city.name: Philadelphia
city.regionLabel: Philadelphia, nearby suburbs and a sensible drive

events.title: OURfest: National Coming Out Day Festival
events.address: Locust and Spruce streets between 12th and 13th streets, Philadelphia, PA
events.description: Celebrate National Coming Out Day with performances, community resources, local vendors and food trucks. The city confirms the street festival will run rain or shine.

events.title: Philadelphia Ballet: Stars and Stripes Forever!
events.description: Philadelphia Ballet opens its season with American works by Robbins, Balanchine and Feld, including Fancy Free, Who Cares? and Stars and Stripes.

events.title: Philadelphia Ballet: Stars and Stripes Forever!
events.description: Philadelphia Ballet opens its season with American works by Robbins, Balanchine and Feld, including Fancy Free, Who Cares? and Stars and Stripes.

events.title: 23rd Street Armory Oktoberfest: Closing Night
events.description: Brauhaus Schmitz turns the armory into a Bavarian beer hall with oompah music, German food and liter steins. General admission is marked sold out; check the remaining VIP option before traveling.
events.priceLabel: Check source; general admission sold out

events.title: Made in Philadelphia Fall Market: 10th Anniversary
events.description: Shop local art, jewelry, glasswork and handmade gifts at the market’s tenth-anniversary fall edition. Admission is free, with food and purchases priced separately.

events.title: Made in Philadelphia Fall Market: 10th Anniversary
events.description: Shop local art, jewelry, glasswork and handmade gifts at the market’s tenth-anniversary fall edition. Admission is free, with food and purchases priced separately.

events.title: Rittenhouse Square Fall Fine Craft Show
events.description: Meet more than 150 fine-craft artists working in ceramics, jewelry, wood, glass and fiber during the final day of this outdoor show. Held rain or shine.

events.title: Liberation at Philadelphia Theatre Company
events.description: Bess Wohl’s play follows a women’s consciousness-raising group in 1970s Ohio. Sunday includes a pre-show conversation about Philadelphia’s women’s liberation movement.

events.title: 8 Seconds Rodeo
events.description: A one-night rodeo celebrating Black cowboy culture brings riders, bulls and live entertainment to Temple’s arena. Check the venue for remaining tickets and entry policies.

events.title: Teddy Swims: The UGLY Tour
events.description: Teddy Swims headlines the arena with St. Paul & The Broken Bones and MarcLo. The Saturday-night bill brings soul, pop and rock to South Philadelphia.

events.title: Philadelphia Union vs. Real Salt Lake
events.description: The Union host Real Salt Lake for a Saturday-night MLS match on Chester’s riverfront. Check official ticket availability before heading to Subaru Park.

events.title: Boo at the Zoo at Elmwood Park Zoo
events.description: Costumes, trick-or-treat stations, a straw maze, games and live music fill the zoo’s seasonal Halloween celebration. Bring a treat bag; the program is included with paid zoo admission.
events.priceLabel: Included with zoo admission; Check source

events.title: Indigenous Peoples Weekend at the Museum of the American Revolution
events.description: Meet Indigenous living-history interpreters, make a wampum-belt craft and learn about Native roles in the Revolution. Lenape social dances on the plaza are free and move indoors in rain.
events.priceLabel: Plaza dances free; indoor programs with admission (Check source)
events.time: Programs 11:00 AM–4:00 PM; dances 11:00 AM, 1:00 PM & 3:00 PM

events.title: Indigenous People’s Weekend at Eastern State
events.description: Special content in the historic site’s guide-led tour and discussion explores how the criminal justice system has affected Indigenous communities across the United States.
events.time: Check source for guide-led tour times

events.title: Philadelphia Open Studio Tours: West of Broad Street
events.venue: Participating artists’ studios west of Broad Street
events.address: Various studios west of Broad Street, Philadelphia, PA; see official directory
events.description: Artists open their working spaces for free self-guided visits, demonstrations and conversation. Use the organizer’s 2026 directory to plan a route among participating west-of-Broad studios.

events.title: OctoberFeast at Peddler’s Village
events.description: Oktoberfest-inspired food and brass bands accompany scarecrows, pumpkin painting, a petting zoo and other family activities. Admission and parking are free; activities and refreshments may cost extra.
events.priceLabel: Free admission and parking; activities extra

events.title: Marcel Duchamp: Opening Weekend
events.description: A major Duchamp retrospective opens with paintings, sculpture, photographs and readymades spanning his influential career. Reserve the exhibition’s timed tickets through the museum.

events.title: Van Gogh’s Sunflowers: Final Day
events.description: The final day to see the museum’s Sunflowers alongside the National Gallery’s version. The focused installation explores Van Gogh’s color and brushwork in Colket Gallery 251.
events.priceLabel: Included with museum admission; Check source

events.title: Foster the People: Good Mourning Sunshine
events.description: Foster the People and Goth Babe play the Mann. Weather update: the show has moved to the covered TD Pavilion, with general-admission seating; existing Skyline Stage tickets are honored.

events.title: Rocky Philadelphia Bus Tours: Season Opening
events.venue: Base of the Art Museum Steps
events.description: Celebrate Rocky’s fiftieth anniversary with a guided bus trip to filming locations and sites from Philadelphia’s boxing history. The tour lasts about two and a half hours.
events.time: 10:00 AM; Check source for additional departures

events.title: BERTHA: Grateful Drag
events.description: A drag-infused Grateful Dead tribute brings a full jam-band show and queer celebration to Brooklyn Bowl. One dollar per ticket supports Philadelphia’s COLOURS Organization.

events.title: Revocation with Defeated Sanity, Fuming Mouth & Weeping
events.description: Revocation leads a four-band metal bill at Underground Arts, joined by Defeated Sanity, Fuming Mouth and Weeping. This is a 21-and-over show.

events.title: Artemas: LOVERCORE / GETTING UP TO NO GOOD Tour
events.description: Artemas brings his dark-pop and R&B songs to Franklin Music Hall with Henry Morris. The venue lists this Saturday tour stop as an all-ages concert.

events.title: Great Lake Swimmers with Colleen Brown
events.description: Great Lake Swimmers and Colleen Brown bring acoustic indie-folk and Americana to MilkBoy. The 21+ standing-room venue is upstairs, with stair access and no elevator.

events.title: MadPlays: MadLibs on Stage
events.description: Two actors perform five unrehearsed pieces shaped by audience prompts in a Spooky Season edition of MadPlays. The upstairs event space is 21 and over and is reached by a staircase.
events.priceLabel: $10 suggested donation; no one turned away for lack of funds

events.title: Ashley Gavin at Helium Comedy Club
events.description: Ashley Gavin headlines Helium with a set emphasizing written material alongside her sharp audience rapport. The showroom has a two-item minimum per person.

events.title: Ashley Gavin at Helium Comedy Club

events.title: 86’d: A Comedy Show for the Service Industry
events.description: Local comics turn restaurant work into stand-up, interviews and stories about memorable customer reviews. Helium’s late Sunday show carries the venue’s two-item minimum.

events.title: The Addams Family: The Musical
events.description: Wednesday Addams falls for a young man from a very different family, setting up a chaotic dinner in this spooky musical comedy. The fall production runs through November 1.

events.title: Parks on Tap at Columbus Square
events.description: Philadelphia’s traveling beer garden stops in Columbus Square for its final scheduled weekend. Meet friends outdoors for a drink and food among the park’s gardens.

events.title: Small Favors: 20th Annual Miniature Exhibition
events.description: Opening-weekend visit to a miniature-art exhibition featuring nearly 400 works in four-inch cubes. Ceramic artists and makers working in other media explore small-scale ideas.

events.title: Autumn’s Colors & Illuminated Fountains at Longwood
events.description: Seasonal gardens and harvest displays lead into illuminated fountain performances after dark. Timed tickets are required; the separate Chrysanthemum Festival begins next weekend, October 16.
events.time: Open until 9:00 PM; illuminated fountains 8:15 PM

events.title: Pumpkinland at Linvilla Orchards
events.description: Explore giant pumpkin displays and seasonal farm scenery, with separately ticketed activities. Saturday’s daytime mazes have ended; evening options include the friendly Witch’s House hayride and Autumn Moon hayride.
events.priceLabel: Free entry; hayrides and activities extra
events.time: Displays until 9:00 PM; evening hayrides until 8:30 PM

events.description: A warehouse haunt combines an industrial nightmare, an abandoned-sanatorium setting and an unholy sanctuary. Open rain or shine; online ticket sales stop at 7 PM, with on-site sales afterward.

events.address: 601 N Church St, Spring City, PA 19475
events.description: Four haunted attractions use elaborate sets and performers in Pennhurst’s historic complex. Arrive fifteen minutes before your timed ticket and be on site before the box office closes.
events.time: Box office 6:30 PM–10:30 PM; timed entry

events.title: Jim Thorpe Fall Foliage Festival
events.address: Broadway and Race St, Jim Thorpe, PA 18229
events.description: A fall road trip for craft vendors, food and live music around Jim Thorpe’s historic downtown. Train excursions cost extra; allow additional time for foliage-weekend traffic and parking.
events.priceLabel: Check source; train rides and purchases extra
events.time: Check source for vendor and music hours

events.title: Dan and Phil: Hard Launch World Tour
events.description: Dan and Phil bring their live stage show to Philadelphia for an evening of comedy, personal stories and onstage oversharing. Check Ensemble Arts for tickets and age guidance.

events.title: Splintered Sunlight: Grateful Dead Tribute
events.description: The long-running Grateful Dead tribute returns to Ardmore Music Hall for a Saturday-night show. The Main Line venue lists this performance for ages 21 and over.
events.age: 21+ unless with parent or legal guardian

events.title: Jessie Ware: The Superbloom Tour
events.description: Jessie Ware brings the Superbloom Tour to the Fillmore, with dhruv on the bill. Check the promoter’s official ticket link for remaining admission and entry details.

events.title: Kelela: new avatar live
events.description: Kelela performs her new avatar live show with keiyaA at the intimate Theatre of Living Arts. The concert adds an electronic-R&B option to Sunday night.

events.title: Westside Cowboy
events.description: Catch Westside Cowboy in the Foundry, the smaller room at the Fillmore complex. The promoter lists the Saturday show as the venue’s evening rock bill.

events.title: Ingrid Andress: Nowhere Else to Go Tour
events.description: Ingrid Andress brings her Nowhere Else to Go Tour to the Foundry for an intimate country-music show. Verify the current ticket options through the promoter.

events.title: Mr. Fantasy: Sexy Saturday Nights Tour
events.description: Mr. Fantasy brings the Sexy Saturday Nights Tour to the Theatre of Living Arts. This pop show is listed on the venue’s official Saturday calendar.

events.title: Six Foot Blonde with Strutman Lane
events.description: Six Foot Blonde’s indie-pop and Strutman Lane’s funk and soul share MilkBoy’s upstairs stage. This 21+ standing-room concert requires stair access; the venue has no elevator.
